notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
Bug Fixes and Improvements


 Physical buttons no longer get stuck when trying to spawn a wall with another wall already in motion.
 Multiple walls in the menu can now be moving at once.
 Reworked audio for the "Ball Maze" puzzle.
 Fixed erratic movement when equipping the "Puzzle Master" hand skin.

notes.title: 3 New Puzzles, 12 Languages and a New Skin!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39746139/ec5c2ffdd5b95cb15ffd1392e9ce93fe854e33af.png

Starcaller has been out just under a month, and we're ready to bring you the first content update!

Here's whats new!


'Artificial Explorer' Hand skin

4RTIF1C1AL was the winner of our first Hands on Competition. As the top Starcaller he helped us design some awesome new hands for the game, available for everyone on page 3 of the Skins wall.

3 New Puzzle Walls, each with 3 difficulty tiers and a secret achievement.


 Pairs
 Lights
 Maze


Localisation support for the following languages:


 French
 Spanish
 German
 Portuguese
 Italian
 Bulgarian
 Russian
 Polish
 Chinese (simplified)
 Japanese
 Arabic

If anyone has any feedback for our localisation, or if any of the languages seem incorrect, let us know on the Steam Community page or on Discord.

Improvements

 The score wall will now save your last used name for local leaderboards. (You still have to hit submit if you want it to be saved)
 Play Ritual and Play Survival have been added to the end menu wall; no longer do you have to go back to the main menu to switch game modes!


Bug Fixes

 Optimized the ropes to be more performant.
 Overall VR input optimization.
 Fixed the hands getting stuck in the floor when starting the game.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Fixes

 The hand offset for the HTC Vive is now fixed!
 The hand offset for the Oculus Rift and Quest is now fixed!
 The hand offset for WMR is now fixed!
 Hands no longer stuck shut with some controllers

notes.title: Starcaller Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
We've been hard at work fixing bugs, and improving the game!

[strike]We understand that Vive / Index users have odd rotations on the hands, we're working on a proper fix for this and will release it ASAP.[/strike] This has now been fixed!

Improvements

 Crystal colliders in the final ritual have been improved to make them easier to grab.
 "You are Number One!" and "Reach for the stars" achievements are now achievable!
 Previously, the chance of getting a tier 2 wall was increased by 10%, and tier 3 wall by 5% after each puzzle completion. Now, the tier 3 chance only increases when the chance of getting a tier 2 reaches 50%, and will also increase by 10%. 
 Increased the time that the description text is visible for the final ritual.
 Polling frequency has been increased from 60 to 120, this should help the hands just feel "nicer"


Fixes

 "Current Ranking" now correctly displays your rank with two players either side of you.
 The "Friends" section on the leaderboard now only populates your entry once.
 Jigsaw pieces are no longer grabbable before the wall has fully locked in, also fixing issues where the floating positions would be offset in some cases.
 The outer ring for the tier 3 "Portrait" puzzle no longer gets stuck in some cases.
 "Play Again" and "Main Menu" buttons no longer break in some cases (If this still happens please let us know).
 Buttons in the main menu no longer break in some cases (If this still happens please let us know).
 The menu music now correctly plays when returning to the main menu, after a long session in Survival mode.
 Pausing now works when attempting to pause more than once in a single ritual.
 "Out of the Blue" achievement skin is no longer unlocked without having the achievement.

notes.title: Do you have what it takes to become the best Starcaller?
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39746139/82b628b4de97c584b917507ee1e295225b620a1f.png

Exclusively for Starcaller's launch, we want to give you the chance to design your very own hand skin for the game!

The rules are simple:


 Play the Ritual game mode between April 2nd and April 16th.
 Submit the best score you can and reach number 1 on the leaderboard.
 Defend your crown from new players by beating anyone who comes close! 

Whoever remains placed number 1 on the Ritual leaderboard by midnight (GMT+0) April 16th will win.

We will then invite you to join us in developing the newest skin for the game including theme, effects and flashy bits! Whatever the chosen design is we will work to ensure it fits the visual styling of Starcaller and the rest of the skin library. Once it's complete it will be added in a future content update, alongside your chosen title for the skin and your steam username!

So... whos the best Starcaller?
I guess we'll find out soon.
